plain.li: This season looks like an ordinary one, nothing out of the way.
[summer] A normal summer by the look of it, some rain and plenty of warm days.
[winter] An ordinary winter coming, cold but nothing worse than usual.
[spring] A normal spring, I'd say, the usual rain and the usual sun.
[fall] An ordinary fall by the signs, nothing to worry about.
[old] I've seen a lot of seasons, and this one looks like most of them.
[lowtech] The birds and the trees are keeping their usual time this year.
[!lowtech] The long-range readings look normal for the time of year.
[child] It looks like a normal season to me.

cheerful.li: An ordinary season, and I'm glad of it.

gloomy.li: Ordinary enough for now, though that never lasts.

warm.li: A quiet season ahead, by the look of it, and we could do with one.

cold.li: Nothing unusual ahead, so the work goes on as usual.

plain.li: This season looks set to be a wet one.
[summer] It'll be a wet summer, the signs all point that way.
[spring] A wet spring coming, the ground will be soft for weeks.
[fall] A wet fall ahead, so get the harvest in while you can.
[winter,rainseason] A wet winter coming, more rain than frost.
[old] My joints have ached for days, so expect a wet season.
[lowtech] The snails are out and the moss is thick, so it'll be a wet season.
[!lowtech] The pressure keeps dropping, so expect a wet season.
[work:Growing] The fields will get plenty of rain this season, maybe too much.
[extreme] I've never seen signs like these, it'll rain and rain this season.

blunt.li: Wet season coming, keep the stores dry.

gloomy.li: It's going to rain all season, I can feel it.

cheerful.li: A wet season, the crops will love it.

warm.li: Keep your boots by the fire, it'll be a wet season.

cold.li: Wet season ahead, so check the roofs now.

plain.li: This season looks like a dry one.
[summer] A dry summer coming, we should watch the fields.
[spring] Not much rain this spring, by the look of the sky.
[fall] A dry fall ahead, the leaves will crackle underfoot.
[old] The air has that dry feel I remember from bad years.
[lowtech] The dew is thin every morning, so it'll be a dry season.
[!lowtech] The forecasts show high pressure sitting over us for weeks.
[work:Growing] The fields will want water this season, the rain won't come.
[extreme] I've never seen it this dry so early, it'll be a hard dry season.

gloomy.li: No rain this season, mark my words.

cheerful.li: A dry season, good for drying the hay at least.

warm.li: Drink plenty, everyone, it'll be a dry season.

cold.li: Dry season ahead, so keep the brush cut back from the walls.

plain.li: This season looks warmer than usual.
[summer] It'll be a hot summer, the heat's already building.
[winter] A mild winter by the look of it, not much frost.
[spring] Spring's come warm and early this year.
[fall] The fall's staying warm, summer isn't letting go.
[old] It's warmer than it should be for the time of year.
[lowtech] The bees are out early, so it'll be a warm season.
[!lowtech] The temperature readings are running high for the time of year.
[extreme,summer] It'll be a scorching summer, keep out of the midday sun.
[extreme,winter] Hardly a winter at all this year, it's that mild.

gloomy.li: Too warm for the time of year, it's not right.

cheerful.li: A warm season, I won't complain.

warm.li: A warm season ahead, easier on the old and the little ones.

cold.li: Warm season ahead, so the food will spoil faster.

plain.li: This season looks colder than usual.
[winter] A cold winter coming, we'll need more firewood.
[summer] This summer won't warm up much, by the feel of it.
[spring] Spring's slow to warm this year.
[fall] The cold's coming early this fall.
[old] My bones say it'll be a cold season.
[lowtech] The animals have thick coats already, so it'll be a cold season.
[!lowtech] The readings are running low for the time of year.
[extreme,winter] A hard winter is coming, cut all the wood you can.
[extreme] It's going to be bitterly cold, worse than anything we've had.

blunt.li: Cold season coming, stack the wood.

gloomy.li: A cold season, and a long one.

cheerful.li: A cold season, good for sitting by the fire.

warm.li: Wrap the little ones up warm, it'll be a cold season.

cold.li: Cold season ahead, so the heaters and fires come first.

plain.li: This season looks set to bring a lot of snow.
[winter] A snowy winter coming, we'll be digging paths every morning.
[old] I remember skies like this, the snow will be deep this year.
[lowtech] The hares turned white early, so expect deep snow.
[!lowtech] The forecasts show snow, and plenty of it.
[child] Will there be enough snow for a really big snowman?
[extreme] I've never seen signs of so much snow, it could bury the fences.

blunt.li: Lots of snow coming, keep the shovels handy.

gloomy.li: Snow and more snow, all season.

cheerful.li: A snowy season, the children will be pleased.

warm.li: Deep snow coming, so check on the old folk often.

cold.li: Heavy snow ahead, so keep the paths to the stores clear.

plain.li: This season looks to bring little snow.
[winter] A winter without much snow, by the look of it.
[old] Hardly any snow this season, I can tell.
[lowtech] The sky's clear and dry, there won't be much snow this season.
[!lowtech] The forecasts show dry cold, not much snow this season.
[child] There won't be any snow for sledding this season, will there?
[extreme] No snow at all this season, I'd wager.

gloomy.li: No snow to speak of, and the cold bites harder without it.

cheerful.li: Not much snow this season, so less shovelling.

warm.li: Little snow this season, so the paths will stay open.

cold.li: Little snow this season, so the ground will freeze hard.

plain.li: Strange weather today, I've not seen this here before.
[weather:AB_PetalStorms] Petals on the wind, where are they all coming from?
[weather:AB_PetalStorms] Look at all these petals, the air is full of them.
[weather:DoubleRainbow] Look, a double rainbow over the fields.
[weather:DoubleRainbow] Two rainbows at once, I've hardly ever seen that.
[weather:RG_Drizzle] Just a drizzle, it'll barely wet the ground.
[weather:RG_Drizzle] This drizzle gets into everything.
[weather:Dust] The wind's picking up dust off the dry ground.
[weather:Dust] Cover your mouth, there's dust in the air.
[weather:VEE_DustStorm] A dust storm, get inside and close the doors.
[weather:DryDuststorm] Dust and lightning, and not a drop of rain with it.
[weather:FogSnow] Snow and fog together, you can't see the end of the yard.
[weather:VEE_Whiteout] A whiteout, nobody go out alone in this.
[weather:VEE_Swelter] The heat is heavy today, it sits on everything.
[weather:RG_FogStorm] Fog and wind together, I can hardly see a thing.
[weather:AB_ReddishRain] The rain's red, the old people say that's a bad sign.
[weather:AB_ReddishRain] Red rain, I don't like the look of it.
[weather:AB_VolcanicAsh] There's ash in the air, it's settling on everything.
[trend:WinterMilder] The winters were colder when we first came here.
[trend:WinterMilder] We used to have proper winters here, not like now.
[trend:WinterHarsher] The winters are harder now than when we came.
[trend:WinterHarsher] We didn't need this much firewood in our first winters.
[trend:SummerHotter] The summers are hotter now than they used to be.
[trend:SummerHotter] Our first summers here were never this hot.
[trend:SummerCooler] The summers aren't as warm as they were when we came.
[trend:SummerCooler] I remember warmer summers in our first years here.
[trend:Wetter] It rains more here than it did in our first years.
[trend:Drier] It rained more when we first came here.
[trend:GrowLonger] The growing season's longer now than when we started.
[trend:GrowShorter] The growing season's shorter now than when we started.
[trend:SnowEarlier] The snow comes earlier now than in our first years.
[trend:SnowLater] The snow comes later every year, it seems.
